name: Bristleback Attack Plans
summary: Bristleback Attack Plans warn of a planned siege on Camp Narache. Quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine drew crude maps and tactical notes for an assault meant to overrun the tauren settlement.

sections.title: A Plot Against the Mesa
sections.body: The Bristleback quilboar plan a sustained assault on Camp Narache. Their leadership means to push beyond skirmishes along the borders of the Red Cloud Mesa and wipe out the young tauren training there. The plans lie deep within a dirt cave in Brambleblade Ravine. Chief Hawkwind can send word to Bloodhoof Village for reinforcements, giving Camp Narache a chance to blunt the invasion before it begins.

faq.q: What do the Bristleback Attack Plans contain?
faq.answer: The plans contain a tactical map and crude instructions for a siege on Camp Narache, showing that the quilboar are organizing a prolonged assault rather than sporadic raids.

aliases: where do i find the map
faq.answer: The plans lie on the dirt floor of an elevated cave in Brambleblade Ravine, just up a side path from the Bristleback chieftain's hut.

faq.q: What does Chief Hawkwind do once he receives the plans?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind uses the plans to summon aid and warriors from Bloodhoof Village to reinforce Camp Narache's defenses.

faq.q: Why are the Bristleback attacking Camp Narache?
faq.answer: The Bristleback claim the thorny ravines as their territory and see the tauren on the mesa as intruders. They aim to drive the settlement out.

angles.text: As a tauren, uncovering the plot helps defend the training grounds where young tauren take their first rites, and protects elders and novices from a quilboar siege.
As a member of the Horde, thwarting the Bristleback offensive helps keep a secure foothold across Mulgore's sacred plains.
